timing_note: Two-rule controlled development rescoring is in progress. This screening and conditional confirmation rule is fixed before inspecting its aggregate or per-dataset alpha2 A2 outcomes; development evidence is exploratory, never a new independent confirmation.

development_screen.strong_definition: SNR=4 and true size is allowed by training caps; this cohort corresponds to n=200/400. Truth is used only in evaluation, never in scoring.

if_screen_fails: Keep original MSIC; do not generate confirmation datasets or search more alpha/scale rules.

if_screen_passes.action: Before fitting any new confirmation dataset, freeze a fresh immutable 80-dataset paired A2 library plan, original MSIC vs the already fixed candidate only.
if_screen_passes.primary_scenarios: Each shape x n=100/200/400 x SNR=2/4 (12 scenarios, 60 datasets), plus each shape x n=400 x SNR=0.5 (2 scenarios, 10 datasets)
if_screen_passes.stress_scenarios: Each shape x n=200 x SNR=2 x rho=0.6 (2 scenarios, 10 datasets)
if_screen_passes.source_dgp: Unchanged original DGP, dimensions32/20/25, n_test500, sigma1, continuous supports; all other settings unchanged
if_screen_passes.approval_note: A failed, incomplete or ambiguous confirmation retains original MSIC. No repeated tuning on confirmation or old LEMON outer tests. A new rule also requires fresh full-refit equivalence checks before any D3 recommendation.
